priorityList: Use Presence when you need to move and need to cast Arcane Blast
Cast Arcane Barrage when you have 4 Arcane Charge stacks and 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo
Cast Arcane Barrage if you have 4 Arcane Charge stacks, at least 5 Arcane Salvo stacks, and Overpowered Missiles
Cast Arcane Missiles when you have less than 3 Arcane Charge stacks
Cast Arcane Missiles whenever you have 2 or more stacks
Only cast Arcane Missiles when you have fewer than 14 Arcane Salvo stacks
Only cast Arcane Missiles when you have fewer than 6 Arcane Salvo stacks if you also have Overpowered Missiles
Cast Arcane Orb when you have 0-2 Arcane Charge stacks
Cast Arcane Blast as your filler
Cast Arcane Barrage if you do not have enough mana for Arcane Blast
Get to 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo via Arcane Blast before Arcane Surge
Cast Touch when it is ready 45 seconds after previous use
